gold_sql:
SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
    p.product_id,
    p.name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 10;
